import os, resource, sys, time
def work():
    value = 0
    for i in range(5000000):
        value += i % 97
    assert value > 0
if sys.argv[1] == 'parent':
    work()
else:
    pid = os.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        work()
        os._exit(0)
    _, status = os.waitpid(pid, 0)
    assert status == 0
print({'parent_cpu': time.process_time(),
       'child_cpu': sum(resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)[:2])})
